name: frostbyte
description: The project tracker for software built with agents. Your agent reads the Frostbyte plan and writes progress, notes and decisions back.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and track what you build
interface.longDescription:
Frostbyte is a project tracker for software built with AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, from a solo founder to a team of ten. It keeps tasks, releases, user requests and decisions in one plan. Your agent connects over MCP, reads the plan before every session and writes progress, decisions and a handoff note back. What's Next reads back your open work, led by the release and priorities you set, and Project Health shows whether the release is on track.

With this plugin you can ask what to work on next, start and finish tasks, put new work in the release and area you name, review user Signals and draft release notes. Tasks stay in progress until the agreed checks pass, and the agent never ships a release on its own.

Works on every Frostbyte plan, Free included. Paid plans are bought on the Frostbyte website; nothing is bought or paid for in the agent.
